title: Deck Footing Concepts — Decks, Porches and Outdoor Structures
body:
Deck Footing Concepts. This record belongs to the Decks, Porches and Outdoor Structures database and covers deck footing concepts in full working detail: what it is, when it applies, how it is set out, and how it is checked. The database as a whole covers deck and porch construction, footings, framing, decking, railings and outdoor structures.

Actual content. Deck Footing Concepts is executed as follows. First, confirm the building type, the project stage and the governing requirements for the jurisdiction, and record those decisions before any dimension or quantity is fixed. Second, lay out the work from the controlling dimensions, keeping clearances, tolerances and interfaces with adjoining work explicit rather than assumed. Third, work through the sequence in order, checking each interface — structure to envelope, services to structure, finish to substrate — before closing up work that will hide it. A complete deck footing concepts entry therefore carries its dimensions, its materials, its sequence, its tolerances and its check results, not a title alone.
